# React Bits Dark Veil

Source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/tree/main/src/ts-default/Backgrounds/DarkVeil

Downloaded 15 November 2026. Original license is retained in LICENSE.md (MIT + Commons Clause). Used as part of the PaisaPilot application.

Local adjustments: re-create immutable WebGL textures on resize; ignore pointer movement while paused/interaction is disabled. Application wrapper supplies reduced-motion, offscreen, and page-visibility pause controls, a static CSS fallback, and a capped rendering resolution.
